# proxmox_node_ceph_crush (Data Source)

Reads the raw Ceph CRUSH map JSON from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/crush`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_crush" "c" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `crush` (String)
